szoveg_eredeti:
Let Tasks in Gemini tackle your to-do list.

At our next Gemini Discord event, a member of our team will demo how Tasks in Gemini can help you tackle big projects, ongoing workflows, and everyday chores, all in the background and under your direction.

👉 Join the Discord to watch live: http://discord.gg/gemini
📅 Tomorrow, November 20 at 11:30am PT
